content.clinicalSnapshot: ⟦NAME_OF_PATIENT_SAMPLE01⟧ presents with a four-month history of low mood and loss of interest occurring alongside persistent, difficult-to-control worry. Anxiety and depressive symptoms are mutually reinforcing, with poor concentration and muscle tension compounding motivational decline. Sleep-onset difficulty adds further daytime fatigue, though treated obstructive sleep apnea may contribute independently. Functional impact is evident in sustained difficulty concentrating across work and home responsibilities.

diagnoses.rationale: This diagnosis accounts for the sustained low mood and loss of interest over the past four months. These symptoms represent the core of the current presentation and the primary driver of functional decline.
